name: Lashmaster
body:
Lashmasters have learned to hone their expertise through the usage of whips and whip-like weapons.

Hit Die: d10

Requirements

To qualify to become a lashmaster, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria:

Skills: Craft (Weapons) 2 ranks, Acrobatics 2 ranks

Feats: Weapon Focus (Whip or Scorpion Whip), Whip Mastery, and Improved Whip Mastery

Base Attack Bonus: +5

Class Skills

The lashmaster’s class skills (and the key ability for each skill) are Acrobatics (Dex), Escape Artist (Dex), and Stealth (Dex).

Skill Points at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Table: Lashmaster
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special
1st	+1	+0	+1	+0	Serpent’s Lash +1d6, Close Quarters
2nd	+2	+1	+1	+1	Whip Maneuvers, Third Hand
3rd	+3	+1	+2	+1	Serpent’s Lash +2d6, Lightning Lash
4th	+4	+1	+2	+1	Strong Lash
5th	+5	+2	+3	+2	Serpent’s Lash +3d6
6th	+6	+2	+3	+2	Powerful Snap
7th	+7	+2	+4	+2	Serpent’s Lash +4d6
8th	+8	+3	+4	+3	Whip Toss
9th	+9	+3	+5	+3	Serpent’s Lash +5d6
10th	+10	+3	+5	+3	Devil’s Whip
Class Features

The following are class features of the lashmaster.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A lashmaster is proficient with all simple weapons, martial weapons, and whips. A lashmaster gains no armor or shield proficiencies.

Serpent’s Lash (Ex)

At 1st level, lashmaster gains the sneak attack ability, but only when using a whip. This additional damage stacks with any sneak attack damage he possesses from other classes. The amount of damage dealt by serpent’s lash increases by 1d6 every 2 lashmaster levels thereafter (to a maximum of +5d6 at 9th level).

Close Quarters (Ex)

At 1st level the lashmaster becomes proficient in striking from afar with his whip, increasing the threatened area of his Whip Mastery feat to an additional 5 feet (effectively encompassing the whip’s entire 15 foot reach). In addition to this, a lashmaster counts his lashmaster levels as fighter levels for the purpose of qualifying for combat feats – however these combat feats only apply to whips he wields.

Whip Maneuvers (Ex)

At 2nd level the lashmaster learns to perform combat maneuvers with his whip with extraordinary skill. Choose a single combat maneuver, if that maneuver isn’t one that could normally be performed with the whip he can now perform that maneuver with his whip. In addition to this, he no longer provokes attacks of opportunity when performing that combat maneuver so long as he uses his whip to perform it.

Lastly, the lashmaster is treated as having 13 intelligence and combat expertise for the purpose of taking combat maneuver feats, however if he takes a feat in this way he can only benefit from these maneuver feats while using his whip.

Third Hand (Ex)

At 2nd level, the lashmaster becomes skilled at using his whip as if it were his own limb. You can utilize the additional uses of your whip listed in the Improved Whip Mastery feat as part of a movement action instead of a standard action.

Lightning Lash (Ex)

At 3rd level, the lashmaster learns how to make a quick and deadly attack with his whip. This is an additional attack at his highest attack bonus, and if he chooses to make this attack he takes a -2 penalty to all attack rolls (including this bonus attack). This does not stack with haste or other effects which grant bonus attacks (such as the Speed weapon special ability).

Strong Lash (Ex)

At 4th level, the lashmaster increases his whip’s damage die to 1d8. If his whip already dealt 1d8 damage or more, he increases its damage die by 1 step as if he had applied the Impact weapon special ability to it.

Powerful Snap (Ex)

At 6th level, the lashmaster can make a single attack against an enemy within his whip’s reach as a standard action. On a successful hit with this attack roll, the opponent takes damage as normal and using that enemy as the origin square he creates a 10 foot burst affecting all enemies within that area. Enemies within the 10 foot burst (including the original target) take a number of sonic damage equal to the amount of sneak attack dice the lashmaster currently possesses and are deafened for 1d4+1 rounds. On a successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + lashmaster level + lashmaster’s Dexterity modifier) the damage is halved, and they are not deafened by this effect.

Whip Toss (Ex)

At 8th level, the lashmaster learns how to use his whip for leverage in tossing items from afar. He can use his whip to throw any thrown weapons (such as alchemist’s fire) with a range as per the sling (50 feet). These make attack rolls like normal (such as an alchemist’s fire being a ranged touch attack) but they apply bonuses which would apply on your whip’s attack rolls onto the thrown weapon’s attack roll.

Devil’s Whip (Ex)

At 10th level, the lashmaster becomes a deadly yet talented artisan of pain and devastation with but a simple whip. A lashmaster increases the critical multiplier of whips he wields by 1, and in addition can use the following technique listed below.

Tornado Lash: As a full-round action the lashmaster can spin their whip in a circle overhead at high speeds, attempting to lash all of those they can. This functions per Whirlwind Attack, this ability grants a +4 bonus for critical confirmation rolls while using Tornado Lash.
